title: Compare cleanup storage for small and empty workspaces
steps: Inspect small workspace with one created photo and empty workspace with no recorded usage.
Open Account cleanup from Tenant Subscription Management.
Set Max photos to 1 and Max storage (MB) to 1 to show the eligible workspaces.

video_guide.summary: Compare the Content values for the empty workspace and the workspace with one small photo. Both storage values are rounded to 0.0 MB.

chapters.note: Account cleanup initially lists the empty workspace with 0 photos and 0.0 MB.

chapters.label: Set cleanup limits and compare Content

chapters.note: After the limits are adjusted, small workspace also appears with 1 photo and 0.0 MB.
The two rows remain indistinguishable by their displayed storage amount.
